from run import *
import os
check('gate-before-root-deploy')
owned=False
root_attempted=False
try:
 (p/'cleanup-journal-root.json').write_text(json.dumps({'path':remote,'phase':'registered-before-create','utc':utc()},indent=2)+'\n')
 shell('mkdir-root-attempt',f'umask 077; mkdir -- {remote}')
 owned=True
 manifest=json.loads((p/'deployment.json').read_text())
 for name,item in manifest.items():
    pushed=run('root-attempt-push-'+name,['push',str(root/item['source']),remote+'/'+name],90,False)
    if pushed.returncode:raise RuntimeError(name+' push failed')
 check('gate-before-root')
 root_attempted=True
 run('root-on',['root','on'])
 shell('root-verify','test "$(id -u)" = 0 && id -u')
 wanted=''.join(f"{item['sha256']}  {n}\n" for n,item in manifest.items())
 shell('root-deploy-verify',env+'ls -laZ && printf %s '+shlex.quote(wanted)+' | sha256sum -c -')
 shell('ldd-perf',env+'/lib/ld-linux.so.3 --list ./perf')
 shell('perf-version',env+'./perf --version')
 shell('perf-list-hw',env+'./perf list hw')
 shell('perf-list-raw',env+'./perf list raw')
 # Continue to the measurement driver only after the deployed binary is verified.
 phase=p/'measure.py'
 if phase.exists():
     exec(compile(phase.read_bytes(),str(phase),'exec'),globals())
finally:
 try:
    if root_attempted:
        run('root-off',['root','off'])
        shell('verify-root-off','test "$(id -u)" = 5001 && id -u')
 finally:
    if owned:
        shell('cleanup-final',f'rm -rf -- {remote} && test ! -e {remote} && test ! -L {remote} && echo verified-absent')
    shell('final-board-state','id -u; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpufreq/policy0/scaling_governor /proc/sys/kernel/perf_event_paranoid /proc/sys/kernel/kptr_restrict')
    run('devices-final',['devices'])
